subject.title: feat(qwen): add Token Plan (Team Edition) provider

question: Should OpenClaw accept Alibaba Model Studio Token Plan as an official qwen provider/config/auth contract in the bundled qwen plugin?
rationale: The implementation is concrete and well-proven, but it adds a new provider id, CLI/auth choices, env var, model catalog, and outbound hosts that repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive product surface.

options.title: Accept bundled provider after catalog refresh
options.body: Regenerate the generated surfaces, resolve the review finding, and let qwen own Token Plan onboarding as an official provider path.

options.title: Route Token Plan outside core
options.body: Close or pause this PR and ask for a ClawHub/plugin package if maintainers do not want to own another Alibaba provider contract.

options.title: Wait for stronger vendor evidence
options.body: Keep the PR open but require maintainer-selected model/region proof before accepting the official contract.

recommendation.title: Accept bundled provider after catalog refresh
recommendation.body: Regenerate the generated surfaces, resolve the review finding, and let qwen own Token Plan onboarding as an official provider path.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the live assignee and introduced the qwen provider/endpoint surfaces this PR extends.
